storage: Wrap the bunch in a damp paper towel inside a box or bag in the fridge for about a week; or stand stems in water, loosely covered. Pick leaves just before use.
looksLike: Bright green, crinkled, oval leaves on thin stems with a strong cool fragrance. Sold in bunches (with or without roots) or as cleaned 100 g packs.
howToPick: Bright green, perky leaves with a strong fresh smell. Avoid yellowing, black spots, slimy leaves or a limp bunch.
shelfLife: Zepto's loose listing shows about 8 days; typically less once cut (general guidance).

usedIn.raw: 5 g per serving (2 tbsp, loosely packed)
